messages.tut.art.welcome: A sunlit valley with a river and a few empty fields.
messages.tut.art.valley: Hands placing a first house beside the river.
messages.tut.art.ready: A small town at dusk with lit windows.
messages.tut.page.welcome.body: A quiet valley is waiting for someone to look after it. That someone is you.
messages.tut.page.valley: Build, one place at a time
messages.tut.page.valley.body: Houses, roads and workshops grow from small choices. There is no hurry and nothing you cannot undo.
messages.tut.page.people.body: Neighbours notice what you do for them, and what you do not. Talk to them; trade with them.
messages.tut.page.ready.body: Choose how to begin. You can replay this story, and change the language, from preferences at any time.
messages.tut.step.move.body: Use the movement keys or the left stick to walk to the river.
messages.tut.step.look-mouse.body: Hold the right mouse button and drag to turn the view.
messages.tut.step.look-pad.body: Move the right stick to turn the view.
messages.tut.step.menu.body: Open the menu to see what you can build.
messages.tut.step.build.body: Choose a house from the build menu and place it on a green square.
messages.tut.step.road.body: Lay two road pieces so people can reach the house.
messages.tut.step.hire.body: Open the workers list and hire your first worker.
messages.tut.step.talk.body: Walk up to the mayor and hear what the valley needs.
messages.tut.step.trade.body: Buy or sell one good at the market.
messages.tut.step.friend.body: Spend time with a neighbour until you become friends.
messages.tut.step.save.body: Press the save button so your valley is kept.
messages.tut.step.grow.body: Welcome ten people to the valley.
messages.tut.hint.move.explain: Movement keys move you across the ground; hold one down to keep walking.
messages.tut.hint.move.show: Walk towards the glowing marker by the river.
messages.tut.hint.menu.nudge: The menu button is in the corner.
messages.tut.hint.build.nudge: Pick a house from the list.
messages.tut.hint.build.explain: A house needs a green square; red squares are taken.
messages.tut.hint.build.show: Select the house in the build menu, then click the glowing square.
messages.tut.hint.road.explain: Roads are placed one piece at a time, next to each other.
messages.tut.hint.hire.nudge: Workers are listed under the workers tab.
messages.tut.hint.talk.show: The mayor is the one standing by the well.
messages.tut.hint.trade.explain: Prices change with what the market has; buy low, sell high.
messages.tut.hint.friend.nudge: A friendship grows when you talk or share a meal.
messages.tut.hint.save.show: The save button is the glowing disk.
messages.tut.tip.paused: The game is paused. Nothing moves until you press play.
messages.tut.tip.menu-hotkey: You can open this menu with a key as well.
messages.tut.tip.road-snap: Roads snap to each other; roads next to a house connect it.
messages.tut.tip.save-habit: You have built a lot since your last save. Saving is quick.
messages.tut.tip.market-prices: Prices are shown in crowns; the arrow shows where they are heading.
messages.tut.tip.friends-gifts: Neighbours enjoy gifts, and remember them.
messages.tut.tip.gamepad-menu: On a gamepad, the shoulder buttons switch menu pages.
messages.tut.tip.growing-valley: The valley is growing. New houses need new roads.
